shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "for f in app/* next.config.ts package.json tsconfig.json; do printf '\\n--- %s ---\\n' \""'$f"; cat "$f"; done'
/bin/bash -lc 'find .. -name AGENTS.md -print && git diff -- package.json && git log -1 --oneline && ls -la __agent_eval__'
/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short && git diff --stat && git diff -- tsconfig.json'

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import time
from urllib.request import urlopen
start = time.monotonic()
with urlopen('http://localhost:3123/') as response:
    chunks = []
    while True:
        chunk = response.read1(65536)
        if not chunk:
            break
        elapsed = time.monotonic() - start
        chunks.append(chunk)
        print(f'{elapsed:.2f}s: {len(chunk)} bytes; shell={b\"Latest Invoices\" in chunk}; data={b\"Acme\" in chunk}')
    body = b''.join(chunks).decode()
    print('dashboard headings:', all(text in body for text in ('Total Revenue', 'Total Invoices', 'Revenue', 'Latest Invoices')))
    print('dashboard data:', all(text in body for text in ('1,200', 'Acme', 'Jan')))
PY"
